name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana provides collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹10 Lakh (and up to ₹20 Lakh under enhanced category) to micro and small non-farm enterprises for income-generating activities.
benefits: Offers collateral-free loans across categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh). No third-party collateral or mortgage is required, and a Mudra debit card is issued for working capital withdrawals.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for non-farm income-generating activities such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector. Borrower must not be a defaulter with any financial institution.
documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN card), address proof (electricity bill, ration card), business project report or quotation for machinery/supplies, and bank statements for the past 6 months.
application_process: Prepare a business project summary and apply online through the Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), Small Finance Bank, or micro-finance institution.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprise entrepreneurs
